user_request: Rendre les compétences de la branche Affaiblissements de zone, dans l’esprit de malédictions lancées sur des groupes, et revoir toute la branche.

proposed_common_rules.targeting: Choose a visible, reachable cell within casting range, including an empty centre. The preview shows the exact affected cells using the existing shared obstacle geometry.
proposed_common_rules.range: Retain the existing growing casting-range curve; this is distinct from the curse area radius.
proposed_common_rules.recipients: All eligible hostiles relative to the caster inside the legal area; no automatic curse on the caster or allies.
proposed_common_rules.application: Resolve application and existing resistance/immunity independently for each victim; one resistant victim does not prevent the others being affected. No new resistance formula.
proposed_common_rules.effect_binding: Apply once at casting, then attach status and remaining duration to each affected actor, including if it leaves the original area. Not a persistent hazardous ground zone; later entrants do not acquire the curse automatically.
proposed_common_rules.potency: Retain each curse effect; the existing damage falloff does not attenuate these non-damaging status applications. Any separate status attenuation remains a distinct future proposal.
proposed_common_rules.reapplication: Preserve the accepted last-application potency and duration refresh rules for the same status; no new stacking/exclusivity rule between different curses.
proposed_common_rules.visuals: Brief group application animation, shared harmful-effect recoil on successful victims, existing compact icon and duration above each affected actor. Remove targeting preview on confirmation.
proposed_common_rules.numbers_not_changed: Other potency, energy, duration and cooldown parameters remain the current baseline for this proposal; no silent balance adjustment.

contagion_proposal.title: Contagion
contagion_proposal.change: At the death of a cursed enemy, transmit its most recent compatible effect to eligible enemies in an area around the corpse, instead of only the nearest enemy.
contagion_proposal.radius: Use the existing range_from_victim_cells progression as the proposed area radius: 2 cells at rank 1, 3 at rank 6, 4 at rank 11 and beyond (cap 4).
contagion_proposal.preserved: Existing inherited-effect weakening, remaining-duration limits, five-effect compatibility, eligible-recipient observation rules and control immunities; no retransmission from a transmitted effect. No active command, energy cost or cooldown added.
contagion_proposal.approval: Proposed only; changing number of recipients and shape is not inferred to be accepted from the general branch instruction.
